description: This file contains a final class Utils in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace. It provides static utility methods for stream manipulation, request modification, URI handling, and other helper functions used internally within the Guzzle PSR-7 implementation.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for various stream and request related operations, URI manipulations, and resource handling in Guzzle HTTP PSR-7.

methods.name: caselessRemove
methods.description: Removes specified keys from an array case-insensitively.

methods.name: copyToStream
methods.description: Copies data from a source stream to a destination stream up to a specified length.

methods.name: copyToString
methods.description: Reads data from a stream into a string up to a specified length.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Calculates a hash of a stream's contents using a specified hashing algorithm.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Clones and modifies a PSR-7 request with specified changes such as headers, URI, method, and body.

methods.name: readLine
methods.description: Reads a line from a stream up to a maximum length.

methods.name: redactUserInfo
methods.description: Redacts the password in the user info component of a URI.

methods.name: streamFor
methods.description: Creates a StreamInterface object from various types of entities such as strings, resources, iterators, or callables.

methods.name: tryFopen
methods.description: Safely opens a file stream, throwing an exception if it fails.

methods.name: tryGetContents
methods.description: Safely reads all contents from a stream into a string, throwing an exception if it fails.

methods.name: uriFor
methods.description: Returns a UriInterface for a given string or UriInterface, creating a new Uri if needed.
